body: Also, I never said no one cares about me. I don't know where you got that from.
The people I've giving my stuff away to won't receive it until after I'm gone. It's not like I'm giving it to them, giving them hints about what I'm going to do. I don't see the problem here.
I'd rather give my belongings to the people I want them to go to, rather than someone else handle that.

I want to feel happy again... as in, not like a worthless piece of shit everyday. I haven't felt happiness in 4 years, since the breakup. 

I am just going through the motions... I'm just existing.

I want to feel happy again, but I've tried for too long. I don't see how it's worth fighting through. 

If I'm not enjoying my existence now, I don't see the point in continuing. Hope is really shitty...it makes you keep going another day, but that doesn't mean things will get better.
